title: Getting started with zuxml
text: xml_parse() takes string raw vector; xml_read() takes file path.
code: doc <- xml_parse(" <catalog>   <book id='b1'><title>The Annotated XML</title><price>29.99</price></book>   <book id='b2'><title>Parsing for Fun</title><price>17.50</price></book> </catalog>")  doc #> <zuxml_document> #> root:     catalog #> nodes:    15   attributes: 2 #> memory:   4.9 Kb #> encoding: not declared

title: Getting started with zuxml
text: Five functions cover traversal. xml_root() gets document element xml_parent() goes back . xml_children() returns every child node, including text comments; xml_elements() returns element children; xml_find() searches descendants. last two take optional name filter — xml_children() , “everything directly ” call. Note xml_children() xml_elements() differ — whitespace tags real text content:
code: root <- xml_root(doc) books <- xml_elements(root, "book") books #> <zuxml_nodeset[2]> #> [1] <book> [2] <book>  xml_find(doc, "title")      # descendants, in document order #> <zuxml_nodeset[2]> #> [1] <title> [2] <title> xml_name(xml_parent(books)) # and back up again #> [1] "catalog" "catalog" xml_type(xml_children(root)) #> [1] "text"    "element" "text"    "element" "text" xml_type(xml_elements(root)) #> [1] "element" "element"

title: Getting started with zuxml
text: Every accessor vectorized. Given nodeset length n get result length n, usually need loop. xml_attrs() returns full attribute set per node, list named character vectors: node nodeset object different lengths, usual vector operations work:
code: xml_name(books) #> [1] "book" "book" xml_attr(books, "id") #> [1] "b1" "b2" xml_text(xml_elements(books, "title")) #> [1] "The Annotated XML" "Parsing for Fun" as.numeric(xml_text(xml_elements(books, "price"))) #> [1] 29.99 17.50 xml_attrs(books) #> [[1]] #>   id  #> "b1"  #>  #> [[2]] #>   id  #> "b2" length(books) #> [1] 2 books[[1]] #> <zuxml_node element> #> book  #> attributes: 1   children: 2 xml_text(rev(books)) #> [1] "Parsing for Fun17.50"   "The Annotated XML29.99"

title: Getting started with zuxml
text: xml_text() concatenates descendant text default. Set recursive = FALSE get node’s direct text children — distinction matters mixed content.
code:
p <- xml_root(xml_parse("

Hello XML world

")) xml_text(p) #> [1] "Hello XML world" xml_text(p, recursive = FALSE) #> [1] "Hello world" xml_text(p, trim = TRUE) #> [1] "Hello XML world"

title: Getting started with zuxml
text: Names matched (namespace, local name). Prefixes reported never decide identity, two prefixes bound URI name. ns argument three modes: Individual parts name available separately:
code: feed <- xml_parse(' <feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom">   <entry><title>First</title></entry>   <entry><title>Second</title></entry> </feed>')  ATOM <- "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" entries <- xml_elements(xml_root(feed), "entry", ns = ATOM) xml_text(xml_elements(entries, "title", ns = ATOM)) #> [1] "First"  "Second" ns_doc <- xml_parse('<r xmlns:a="urn:a"><a:i/><i/></r>') r <- xml_root(ns_doc)  length(xml_elements(r, "i"))                # NULL: any namespace #> [1] 2 length(xml_elements(r, "i", ns = "urn:a"))  # that URI #> [1] 1 length(xml_elements(r, "i", ns = NA))       # no namespace at all #> [1] 1 item <- xml_elements(r, "i", ns = "urn:a") c(name = xml_name(item), local = xml_local(item),   ns = xml_ns(item), prefix = xml_prefix(item)) #>    name   local      ns  prefix  #>   "a:i"     "i" "urn:a"     "a"

title: Getting started with zuxml
text: Order, attributes, text namespace semantics preserved, round trip stable. Original formatting preserved — quote style, whitespace attributes CDATA boundaries retained. xml_write() sends output file, xml_read() reads one back:
code: xml_serialize(books[[1]]) #> [1] "The Annotated XML29.99" once <- xml_serialize(xml_parse("")) twice <- xml_serialize(xml_parse(once)) identical(once, twice) #> [1] TRUE f <- tempfile(fileext = ".xml") xml_write(doc, f) identical(xml_serialize(xml_read(f)), xml_serialize(doc)) #> [1] TRUE
